decisions.title: Go for agent and relay core
decisions.decision: Use Go for the device agent and relay-server core.
decisions.rationale: Single-binary cross-platform distribution, straightforward concurrency, and a small runtime dependency surface.

decisions.title: Structured capabilities before raw shell
decisions.decision: Structured capabilities are the default execution interface; raw shell is privileged.
decisions.rationale: Reduce prompt-injection blast radius and keep local policy decisions explicit and auditable.

decisions.title: Outbound-only device networking
decisions.decision: Normal device connectivity originates outbound from the user PC.
decisions.rationale: Avoid exposing inbound services on user machines and work across NAT/firewalls more safely.
